method: Every 2024 Andhra Pradesh Assembly result was checked against the official Election Commission of India result pages, archived on web.archive.org (the live ECI site no longer hosts the June 2024 pages). Canonical archived-ECI URL pattern: https://web.archive.org/web/2024/https://results.eci.gov.in/AcResultGenJune2024/ConstituencywiseS01{N}.htm (N = AC number, no zero padding). Each loaded page was checked for the ECI 'Last Updated at 08:55 am On 05/06/2024' final-data stamp; margins recomputed as winner votes minus runner-up votes. Vote share tolerance 0.05pp; margin must match exactly. Name variants (transliteration, initials, aliases) accepted as the same person where party and constituency agree.
